notes.title: Patch rolling out to VHR now!
notes.content:
Hello folks!

A patch is rolling out to Steam right now to address some issues, please see the patch notes below:

UI[list]
[*]UI elements layering incorrectly in the Championship menu have been fixed
[*]Arcade GP menu no longer accepts input once the user has pressed "back" to go back to the main menu
[*]Fixed transition back into Championship after selecting "no" when the option to continue from where you left off appears 
[/list]Gameplay[list]
[*]Time Attack best times now save properly
[/list]Audio[list]
[*]Audio balancing with the rival gate unlock sound and the unlock song have been fixed 
[/list]
I also wanted to say a huge thank you to everyone who has reviewed the game on Steam so far, we recently hit the incredible "Overwhelmingly Positive" label for the game which has been incredibly heartening to see, from everyone at Skydevilpalm and Playtonic Friends. 

Thank you again for your incredible continued support and all of the constructive feedback we've recieved so far! Keep it coming! We'll have more news about future VHR stuff soooon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594060/Victory_Heat_Rally/

notes.title: VHR - Hotfix rolling out now!
notes.content:
Yo!

A small hotfix for some issues is rolling out right now!

Please see below:

- Versus CPU difficulty can now be properly adjusted
- The "Rally" series of achievements now correctly track the right progression stat
- Engine audio and driver voice clips have had their gain increased to better balance audio
- Win/Lose rival cutscenes now play correctly on the overworld map, accordingly
- Steam screenshots are now working correctly
- Japanese language text now wraps properly in cutscenes

We'll have more news on the next patch as soon as possible. Thanks for all of your feedback so far, please keep it coming as we look towards future updates :)

notes.title: Victory Heat Rally Shakedown Demo Gold is here!
notes.content:
Hey Racers!

We know you’ve been waiting for more information about Victory Heat Rally and today we’re excited to drop a BRAND NEW demo for [b]Steam’s Race Fest![/b]


[b]What’s new?[/b]

[list]
[*] Split screen for local co-op. Grab a friend and see who’ll become the track champion!
[*] A tutorial with the Chief. He’ll give you the low down on what’s what.
[*] Even more tracks that will test your mettle.
[*] Updated visuals
[*] More commentary from Sally on VHN
[/list]And more!


We'd love to hear your feedback in the forums, so if you have a moment after trying out the new demo, head on over to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1594060/discussions/]forums[/url].

Now go out there, Victory is just ahead! And don’t forget to wishlist Victory Heat Rally too.
